text:
With a piece of charcoal
+
+with my broken chalk and my red pencil
+
+to draw your name
+
+the name of your mouth
+
+the sign of your legs
+
+upon nobody’s wall
+
+
+Upon the forbidden door
+
+to carve the name of your body
+
+until the blade of my knife
+
+bleeds
+
+and the stone cries out
+
+and the wall breathes like a chest

translation.title: With a Piece of Charcoal…
translation.editorial_note: The infinitives retain the poem’s incantatory incompletion; inscription passes from charcoal and chalk to a blade until inert surfaces acquire blood, voice, and breath.
